findings.quote: having been compelled to wage three wars over them
findings.problem: τριττοὺς πολέμους ἀναγκασθέντες πολεμεῖν αὐτοῖς: αὐτοῖς is dative of the peoples (the Lycians and Carians), i.e. wars waged against/with them, not wars 'over' the regions.
findings.proposed_fix: having been compelled to fight three wars against them

units.note: Numbers (200 talents, 120 talents, 1,000,000 and 150,000 drachmas) all match. Remainder accurate.
The antecedent of αὐτῶν in 'τοῖς φίλοις αὐτῶν' is grammatically ambiguous; the English takes it as the senate's (Rome's) friends, which suits the context. No change proposed.
